creative_direction: Depict Usopp with his recognizable long nose, dark curls, and goggles resting high on his head so both eyes are unobstructed. Give him a simple olive casual shirt and an easy proud smile. Turn his shoulders slightly without distorting the face. Keep the portrait crop above the elbows and omit slingshots, equipment bags, or boastful action gestures. Use pale stone paper. Use matte gouache, short deliberate brush marks, and a softly mottled but uncluttered background. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
